title: Moving On and Picking Up a Topic

sections.content: You know *en cuanto* ("as soon as") from A2 Unit 27 and *además* from A2 Unit 28. This lesson adds three phrases that keep a talk moving. *Pues bien* ("well then", "right") closes what you have just said and moves on to the next step. *En cuanto a* ("as for") picks out one topic from several and comments on it. *Por lo que se refiere a* ("as far as ... is concerned") does the same job and sounds more formal. With these phrases you can go through a list of topics one by one.

sections.title: Three ways to keep a talk moving
rows: Pues bien, ya conocemos el problema; ahora busquemos una solución.
Well then, we now know the problem; now let us look for a solution.
En cuanto a la comida, yo me ocupo.
As for the food, I will take care of it.
Por lo que se refiere al transporte, hay un autobús cada hora.
As far as transport is concerned, there is a bus every hour.

sections.content: After *en cuanto a* and *por lo que se refiere a* comes a noun phrase: *en cuanto a la comida*, *en cuanto al transporte* (*a* + *el* = *al*). With a verb, *en cuanto* alone means "as soon as" and takes the subjunctive for the future: *En cuanto llegues, llámame*. Do not confuse the two.
